Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1105
Claimant:
Christine Yoder
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
June 23, 2024
Claim opened after the policyholder reported a low-speed collision while backing out of a space in a parking lot. The
claimant's vehicle was the other car involved, and the claimant is represented by counsel, so all further contact goes
through the attorney's office.
June 25, 2024
Reviewed the statement from the policyholder, who confirms the impact occurred as described when backing out.
The driver is a household member living with the policyholder and is covered under the policy as such.
June 27, 2024
Obtained photographs of both vehicles and the parking area. The damage on the claimant's vehicle lines up with the
impact the policyholder described.
July 25, 2024
Spoke with two witnesses who saw the collision from a nearby walkway. Both independently described the same
sequence of events the policyholder gave.
October 20, 2024
Contacted the other driver, who gave an account consistent with the policyholder's version. No prior damage to the
claimant's vehicle appears in our records or the inspection notes.
November 1, 2024
Claimant's counsel forwarded a medical report dsecribing a wrist fracture. The injury is plausible for a collision of this
type, and no earlier injury to the same area is on file.
November 7, 2024
Reviewed treatment records. Care followed a typical course, with the claimant's symptoms easing steadily as
recovery progressed and treatment tapering off accordingly.
November 15, 2024
Took a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account matched what the claimant told the intake
team and the treating clinic, and it has stayed consistent across every conversation.
December 11, 2024
The file does not make clear exactly where the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time of impact. Requested
clarification from counsel and noted it as an open item for follow-up.
December 18, 2024
Nothing in the vehicle history or the policy records suggests the damage predates the coverage period. Reviewing the
claim against the documented facts, with the seating position as the one open question, before a settlement
recommendation is prepared.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
